caption:
Household debt hit $19.1 trillion.
The New York Fed says 5.0% of it is in some stage of delinquency, up from 4.7% three months earlier.
Credit cards were a bright spot: serious delinquency flow eased to 6.87%.
Are you seeing it in your own budget?
